# Can your short-term rental loss offset your other income in 2026?

> Free calculator for short-term rental owners: does your Airbnb or VRBO escape rental-activity status (average stay of 7 days or less) and qualify as non-passive through material participation? Compare the $25,000 passive path and estimate first-year cost segregation depreciation with 100% bonus.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
